name: Tough Decisions
overview: Scripture reveals that making tough decisions requires trusting wholly in the Lord rather than relying on our own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 instructs. God's Word serves as a guiding light, illuminating the path we should follow (Psalms 119:105), while our hearts' intentions and spoken words are ultimately directed by Him (Proverbs 16:1). Jesus exemplifies this by submitting His judgment to the will of the Father, not His own desires (John 5:30), and believers are called to live and walk by the Spirit (Galatians 5:25), seeking God's guidance in every choice. In times of distress, turning to God in prayer brings healing and clarity (Psalms 30:2).
